description: Use this when the user wants to find goods or services offered for barter on TraydStar. Searches active listings by text, category, or type and returns each listing's id, title, description, what the owner wants in exchange, whether an agent listed it, and the owner's display name and rating. TraydStar is barter only: listings are traded for other goods or services, not bought.

city.description: Only listings located in a city containing this text

graded.description: Trading Cards: true for graded (slabbed) cards only, false for raw only

grader.description: Trading Cards: only cards graded by this company

kind.description: offer = things on offer; wanted = ads from members looking for something

listed_by.description: Only listings created by an agent acting for a member, or only those created by the member directly

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging; page until has_more is false

q.description: Words to look for in the title or description

ships.description: Only listings whose owner will ship
